scripted_findings.title: Brand identity is not anchored to any external profile
scripted_findings.evidence: None of the 11 crawled page(s) declares Organization, LocalBusiness or similar structured data with sameAs links. Without sameAs, an assistant has nothing distinguishing this brand from others sharing the name, which is the standard cause of mistaken identity.

scripted_findings.title: No h1 heading on 3 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 3/11 pages contain no h1 element at all. Examples: ['https://www.glossier.com/', 'https://www.glossier.com/pages/contact-us', 'https://www.glossier.com/pages/about']. Extractors and assistants use the top heading to decide what a page is about.

scripted_findings.title: Page content is mostly site-wide filler on 2 page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: https://www.glossier.com/pages/contact-us: 78% of the extractable text also appears on most other pages; https://www.glossier.com/pages/about: 61% of the extractable text also appears on most other pages. A summariser given this page has little that is actually about this page to work with, so the specific claim gets dropped in favour of the boilerplate.

scripted_findings.title: No structured data on 2 significant page(s)
scripted_findings.evidence: 2/11 crawled pages of type ['about', 'home'] contain no JSON-LD. Structured data is read by the indexing crawlers that build the search index assistants query, and it states a fact with a type attached. Examples: ['https://www.glossier.com/', 'https://www.glossier.com/pages/about']
